name: Let's Play: Ancient Greek Punishment: Chess Edition
author: Pippin Barr
description: Chess! It already feels like a punishment to so many people! But now even more so! What if Zeus threw chess sets instead of lightning bolts?! What if Archimedes was a vengeful god?! What if you just kept getting chessed for eternity?! Let's Play: Ancient Greek Punishment: Chess Edition is yet another new edition in the Let's Play: Ancient Greek Punishment series, focusing on a retelling of five (kind of) mythological punishments. In Chess Edition each punishment is expressed in the language of chess!
